description: This file defines classes and functions for generating code snippets for API requests in multiple programming languages (JavaScript, Python, C#, Java). It includes classes implementing a common interface to produce language-specific code for making HTTP requests based on HAR request data.

classes.name: JSCodeGen
classes.description: Generates JavaScript code for API requests, with methods for pretty-printing objects and string literals.

classes.name: PythonCodeGen
classes.description: Generates Python code for API requests, with methods for pretty-printing objects and string literals.

classes.name: CSharpCodeGen
classes.description: Generates C# code for API requests, with methods for pretty-printing objects and string literals.

classes.name: JavaCodeGen
classes.description: Generates Java code for API requests, with methods for pretty-printing objects and string literals.

methods.name: generatePlaywrightRequestCall
methods.description: Generates language-specific code to perform a Playwright request based on HAR request data.

methods.name: getAPIRequestCodeGen
methods.description: Factory function returning an instance of the appropriate code generator class based on the specified language.
